verdict.rationale: The only source-related evidence is a public GitHub repo for a peripheral component, the local MCP server (motherduckdb/mcp-server-motherduck). Nothing in the pack shows the core MotherDuck cloud warehouse source is published, and no license is named for any repo. Missing for 10: published source for the core service, an explicit open license (e.g. MIT/Apache) for any MotherDuck code, and independent confirmation of openness.
